title: Final review of the gvc diff
description:
Review the epic's full diff and resolve or route every finding before close-out unblocks.

Four things specific to this epic, because they are what it could plausibly get wrong:
  - Can a cold re-derivation from git reach a SMALLER epic than the warm run reached?
    That is the axiom 1 failure absorption introduces and the one most likely to be
    subtly wrong.
  - Is an observation ever overridden by a prediction anywhere in the code? The two-tier
    rule collapses if it is.
  - Is an UNVERIFIED acceptance item anywhere treated as false? That silently makes
    every unrunnable item non-gating, which is exactly the false negative this epic
    exists to prevent.
  - Is the threshold still biased toward absorbing, with the cost asymmetry written
    where the next person to tune it will read it?
